_about: Puzzle Maker's public launch (Jorge, Nov 13, 2026): Monday, November 23, 2026, 9:00 AM ET. It is #1; earlier days are unranked previews. The leaderboard and badges count from it (badges: the same day). Everything else switches on by itself at that moment in hoopsmatic-worker (PUZZLE_MAKER_LAUNCH: indexing, sitemap, burger row, games roster). start: the first data-built Daily lock. scripts/build.mjs copies launch and badges to public/config.json, which the page and the server read.
